skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Whispered Longing
skins.content: 0011 Yun Series/Whispered Longing. Clothes Lutonada wore while taking a spring walk through Yan. An organic mixture of traditional and modern elements form a refreshing, graceful style that does not sacrifice charm. All sorts of accessories add to the cuteness.
skins.quote: Dressed in beautiful clothes, and flying a kite during a beautiful spring day. Now, these last wishes were complete. Lutonada wants to hop down from the wall, but she didn't expect a fowlbeast to nip at her bracelet. She hesitates for a moment, before deciding to stay a little longer.
